    About me

    From the classroom to remote operations

    I started as a Physics graduate and teacher, moved into business development at SIRCLO, then spent seven years building two e-commerce brands. Today I work remotely, helping teams keep their stores, leads and schedules in order.

    B.Sc. Physics, State University of Malang2009 to 2013
    Built analytical and research skills. Team Leader of a PKM-P research grant funded by Indonesia's Ministry of Education, Culture, Research and Technology (2013) and Team Member of PKM-GT (2010).
    Laboratory internship, PT Barata IndonesiaApril to May 2012

    Teacher, SDIT Al Ibrah2014
    Prepared semester lesson plans and learning materials, used creative teaching methods and focused on character building for students.
    Private tutor
    Gave personalized academic support tailored to each student's needs and learning goals.
